games:2026-wk10-alabama-lsu.blurb: No. 5 Alabama goes to Baton Rouge a 6-point underdog against No. 14 LSU in a rivalry game with real playoff consequence. ESPN gives the Tigers a 57% edge at home, and a loss would stall Alabama's pursuit of the SEC's top spot.

games:2026-wk10-georgia-ole-miss.blurb: No. 2 Georgia is a 3.5-point favorite on the road against No. 10 Ole Miss, one of the few spots all year the Bulldogs are close to a coin flip (55.5% per ESPN). A 56.5 total points to a shootout in Oxford with SEC positioning on the line.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-boise-state-co.blurb: No. 25 Boise State is a 17.5-point favorite at Colorado State with a 68.5 total, and ESPN gives the Broncos a 93% chance. Anything less than a comfortable win would cost them in the poll.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-merrimack-wake.blurb: No. 16 Wake Forest is favored by 47.5 over Merrimack, so the only real question is how early the starters come out. A tune-up, with the over/under set at 58.5.

predictions:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest dipped from 14 to 16, and the analytics are split -- 11th in FPI but all the way down at 25th in SP+. The ACC schedule ahead will decide which number is telling the truth.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: Georgia at No. 2 holds the SEC's automatic bid, but No. 5 Alabama is only three spots back -- close enough that one bad Saturday flips the league's playoff representative.

bubbleNotes:lsu.blurb: LSU nudged up a spot to the 15 seed but still sits three places outside the field. Hosting No. 5 Alabama is exactly the kind of result that could change that in a hurry.

games:2026-wk10-miami-notre-dame.blurb: The No. 1 team in the country walks into South Bend as a 7-point underdog, with ESPN's model giving Notre Dame a 60.5% edge. A total of 54.5 suggests points are available, and Miami's hold on the top spot is the thing on the line.

games:2026-wk10-byu-utah.blurb: Rivalry week in the Big 12: No. 9 BYU at No. 3 Utah, with the Utes laying 4 and carrying a 65.8% win probability. A low 48.5 total points to a grinder, and the Big 12's automatic bid picture runs straight through it.

games:2026-wk10-kentucky-tennessee.blurb: No. 6 Kentucky is the higher-ranked team but the underdog, with Tennessee favored by 5.5 at home and holding a 66.7% win chance. The Vols sit at No. 14 in the field and badly need this one; the Wildcats need it to protect a top-six perch.

games:2026-wk10-oregon-ohio-state.blurb: No. 23 Oregon heads to Columbus as a 7.5-point dog against No. 12 Ohio State, with ESPN giving the Buckeyes an 83.2% shot. The total is just 45.5, and Ohio State is playing from the No. 13 seed line, a spot outside the field.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-texas-missouri.blurb: No. 7 Texas is a 3-point favorite at No. 18 Missouri, with ESPN's model closer to 71% on the Longhorns. The 42.5 total says both defenses are expected to show up.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-cincinnati-hou.blurb: No. 17 Houston hosts Cincinnati as a 10.5-point favorite with an 83.9% win probability, and the 61.5 total is the highest on the board this week. Style points matter for the Cougars' ranking.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-ucla-minnesota.blurb: No. 8 UCLA goes to Minnesota favored by 4.5 with a 67.7% win chance, and the 38.5 total hints at a slog. The Bruins are the closest chaser in the Big Ten race, so a slip here is costly.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-west-virginia-.blurb: No. 15 Texas Tech is a 16.5-point home favorite over West Virginia with an 89.4% win probability. Sitting at the No. 16 seed, the Red Raiders need the convincing kind of win here.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-oklahoma-flori.blurb: No. 24 Florida lays 6 at home against Oklahoma and draws a 64.6% win chance from ESPN's model. With a 45.5 total, the Gators' spot in the rankings hinges on a tight, low-scoring afternoon.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-iowa-northwest.blurb: No. 19 Iowa is favored by 2.5 at Northwestern, but ESPN's model actually leans the other way at 55.2% for the Wildcats. A 43.5 total fits the profile of a one-possession Big Ten grind.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-tcu-arizona.blurb: No. 22 Arizona hosts TCU as a 7-point favorite with a 73.8% win probability. The Wildcats are the ranked side here and have more to lose than to gain.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk10-texas-a-m-sout.blurb: No. 21 South Carolina is a 7-point favorite over Texas A&M, though ESPN's model has it nearly even at 54.1%. The 52.5 total suggests the Gamecocks may need to outscore rather than out-grind.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: A tumble from No. 2 to No. 12 hasn't changed what the computers think: Ohio State is No. 1 in SP+ and No. 2 in FPI, the biggest gap between poll and model in the country.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky climbed from No. 9 to No. 6, but the models are unconvinced -- 31st in SP+ and 26th in FPI. The Wildcats will get a chance to settle the argument at Tennessee.

predictions:notre-dame.blurb: Notre Dame dropped from No. 5 to No. 11 while sitting No. 1 in FPI and No. 3 in SP+. Hosting No. 1 Miami as a favorite is the quickest route back up.

predictions:utah.blurb: Utah jumped from No. 6 to No. 3, out in front of its profile -- the Utes are 10th in both SP+ and FPI. The rivalry game with No. 9 BYU is the test that validates the ranking.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: Indiana holds the Big Ten's automatic bid at No. 4, with UCLA four spots back at No. 8 -- close enough that one Bruins statement win reframes the whole race.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: Utah owns the Big 12's auto bid at No. 3 with BYU six spots behind at No. 9, and the two settle it head-to-head in Salt Lake City.

bubbleNotes:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State sits at the No. 13 seed, one spot from the field after a 10-spot slide. No. 23 Oregon comes to Columbus with a chance to push the Buckeyes further out.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech has slipped two spots to the No. 16 seed, four spots from the field, with an unranked opponent up next -- not much room left for a bad afternoon.

bubbleNotes:tennessee.blurb: Tennessee is trending the right way, up three spots to the No. 14 seed and two from the field. Hosting No. 6 Kentucky is exactly the win that closes that gap.
